components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 160px;align-items:start;gap:16px;max-width:480px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule-soft,#e7eae1);font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Variable',sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#173b32);line-height:1.5}.ds-label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:550}.ds-range{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:var(--muted,#58675e);font-size:11px}.ds-input-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;height:32px;font-size:13px;border:1px solid var(--input-rule,#7d8d80);background:var(--surface,#ffffff)}.ds-input-wrap:focus-within{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#346c57);outline-offset:3px}.ds-input-wrap:has([aria-invalid='true']){border-color:var(--negative,#a54120)}.ds-input{width:100%;min-width:0;height:100%;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;padding:6px 10px;color:var(--ink,#173b32);font:inherit;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;caret-color:var(--ink,#173b32)}.ds-unit{padding-right:10px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#58675e);pointer-events:none}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-field{padding:14px 0}.ds-label{font-size:15px}.ds-range,.ds-unit{font-size:12px}.ds-input-wrap{height:44px;font-size:16px}}@media(max-width:420px){.ds-field{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 155px;gap:12px}}

components.css: .ds-ledger{background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#173b32);border:1px solid var(--rule,#ccd2c7);font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Variable',sans-serif;line-height:1.5}.ds-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-table-head th{padding:8px 12px;background:var(--table-head,#f8f9f4);font-size:11px;font-weight:550;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#ccd2c7)}.ds-table th,.ds-table td{text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}.ds-table tr>:first-child{text-align:left}.ds-table-body th,.ds-table-body td{padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule-soft,#e7eae1);font-size:13px}.ds-table-body th{font-weight:600}.ds-table-body tr:last-child>*{border-bottom:0}.ds-table-body tr:hover{background:var(--table-head,#f8f9f4)}.ds-positive{color:var(--positive,#28704c)}.ds-negative{color:var(--negative,#a54120)}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-table,.ds-table-body{display:block}.ds-table-head{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%)}.ds-table-body tr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px 12px;padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule-soft,#e7eae1)}.ds-table-body tr:last-child{border-bottom:0}.ds-table-body th,.ds-table-body td{height:auto;min-height:34px;padding:0;border:0;text-align:left;font-size:16px;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-table-body th{display:flex;align-items:center;font-size:16px}.ds-table-body td::before{content:attr(data-label);display:block;color:var(--muted,#58675e);font-size:12px;line-height:1.35;margin-bottom:2px}}

components.css: .ds-error{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:16px;background:var(--error-surface,#fbefe5);border:1px solid var(--negative,#a54120);color:var(--ink,#173b32);font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Variable',sans-serif;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}.ds-error p{margin:4px 0 0}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-error{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;padding:16px;font-size:14px}}.ds-button-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:32px;padding:6px 12px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#173b32);border:1px solid var(--ink,#173b32);border-radius:4px;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Variable',sans-serif;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease-out}.ds-button-secondary:hover{background:var(--rule-soft,#e7eae1)}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#346c57);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-button-secondary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}.ds-button-secondary svg{width:14px;height:14px;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;fill:none}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-button-secondary{min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;font-size:15px}.ds-button-secondary svg{width:18px;height:18px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-secondary{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
The finished interface is a compact working sheet. Warm paper surrounds a white ledger; deep green ink, thin rules, and aligned numerical columns give the data its hierarchy. The tone is restrained, orderly, and practical.

The desktop layout uses dense rows and small controls. Phones retain larger values and touch targets, with all five metrics visible in each instrument group. Short headings and plain state text keep attention on the data. Self-hosted IBM Plex Sans and small authored SVGs provide the visual identity; there are no shipping raster assets.
keyCharacteristics: Tabular figures and aligned numerical columns.
Dense desktop rows with larger mobile values.
All five metrics visible in each mobile instrument group.
Compact controls, clear focus, and concise state text.

rules.name: The State With Words Rule
rules.body: Producer state is plain text beside Pause/Resume, and colored imbalance retains its signed number.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Working surfaces remain flat; dividers and tonal changes distinguish their roles.

dos: **Do** retain tabular figures and desktop numerical alignment.
**Do** keep all five metrics visible within each mobile instrument group.
**Do** preserve readable mobile values and 44px mobile control targets.
**Do** pair imbalance color with its signed value and retain plain producer state.
**Do** preserve visible focus and the stronger input boundary.
**Do** use the existing flat surfaces, thin rules, compact controls, and concise labels.
**Do** honor the existing reduced-motion preference, which removes transitions.
donts: **Don't** introduce decorative tick animation; the ledger updates quietly.
**Don't** hide mobile metrics behind horizontal scrolling or expansion.
